question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Approbate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reject**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Approbate"** means to officially approve or sanction something. (स्वीकृत करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The committee **approbated** the new policy after thorough deliberation.
 
 
 
• **"Reject"** refers to the act of refusing to accept, believe, or approve something. (अस्वीकृत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The board **rejected **the proposal due to insufficient evidence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'approbate'** is **'reject'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reject**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accept **(स्वीकार करना): To consent to receive or agree to something.

 
 
• **Example:** She **accepted **the invitation to join the event.
 
 
 
• **Permit** (अनुमति देना): To allow something to happen or to give authorisation.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher **permitted **the students to leave early.
 
 
 
• **Supply** (आपूर्ति करना): To provide something that is needed or desired.
 
 
• **Example:** The company **supplies **high-quality materials to construction firms.
 
 

31:Tc87,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 (bite the bullet)**.
